**v1.14.3: the bot presses X at quest objects whose prompt says "Press X to Interact", such as the Well Stones in Savannah.**

- **Fixed: "the bot forgot how to press X" at the Well Stones.**
  - **What was wrong:** for a "Collect ..." goal, the bot pressed X only when it read the object's name on the prompt, and the OCR often misreads that name. Its fallback for a misread name needed the goal's own verb ("Press X to Collect"). The Well Stones say "Press X to Interact", so the bot never pressed X. While collecting, it also pressed X only when standing almost on top of the item, which a solid rock pile (or a mount) doesn't allow. Seen on "Collect Well Stones in Savannah" on 2026-11-17.
  - **Now:** a prompt that says "Interact" counts as the object's own when the nearest quest object is within reach (300) on the same floor and no other named thing is nearer. This works when walking to each object, waiting at the goal, and collecting. While collecting, the bot presses X once it's in reach and the prompt is up, at most twice per object before it tries another one.
  - **Still never pressed:** prompts that show Crowns, teleports, World Gates, shops and other NPCs' talk prompts. While collecting, talk and shop prompts are now refused too. Before, they were pressed.
- **Checked:** 62 new and 15 earlier stub tests of these checks pass, the five release scripts load, and 888 of 889 vision tests pass. `test_ahk_names`' speedhack path test errors, as on v1.12.0. Not tried in the game yet.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install. Your settings, learned cards, routes and recorded battles are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
